name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
summary: In Dun Morogh, Tundra MacGrann needs his winter stores back from Old Icebeard. The injured hunter cannot reach the yeti's cave himself.

sections.title: Winter Stores and Stolen Lockers
sections.body: Tundra MacGrann had salted away a month's worth of dried meat for the cold season. He lives beyond the warmth of Kharanos and Ironforge, where surviving winter takes careful preparation. To keep hungry bears from his provisions, he locked them in a thorium-reinforced meat chest. Old Icebeard carried the whole chest away rather than trying to open it.

sections.title: Old Icebeard's Den
sections.body: Old Icebeard stole the chest while MacGrann was away hunting deer and dragged it to a cave in the jagged hills. MacGrann believes the yeti cannot break through solid thorium, but his injured leg keeps him from retrieving the stores. Anyone entering the cave must face the beast or slip inside while it prowls the snowdrifts.

faq.answer: Tundra MacGrann is a dwarven hunter who lives in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. With an injured leg, he depends on his stored provisions to get through winter.
Old Icebeard, a local yeti, stole MacGrann's meat locker while the hunter was away hunting deer and dragged it into its mountain cave.

faq.q: Why can't MacGrann get his meats back himself?
faq.answer: An injured leg keeps MacGrann from moving quickly or quietly enough to enter Old Icebeard's cave and escape safely.

faq.q: Did the yeti eat the food?
faq.answer: No. The dried meat is locked inside a solid thorium chest. Old Icebeard carried it away but cannot break through the metal.

faq.q: Do you have to fight Old Icebeard to get the meat locker?
aliases: do i have to kill icebeard
faq.answer: You can slip into the cave while Old Icebeard is out prowling and retrieve the locker without fighting him.

faq.q: Where is the stolen stash located?
faq.answer: The stolen meat locker is deep inside Old Icebeard's mountain cave, in the hills near MacGrann's camp in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a hunter, you know how much work goes into preserving meat. MacGrann lost his stores to a beast while he was out tracking deer.
As a dwarf, you know how hard a mountain winter can be. Without preserved meat or shelter, even a seasoned mountaineer may not withstand the cold.
As a rogue, you can slip into Old Icebeard's cave while he is away and take the locker without drawing a blade.
